cards.use: accomplish a goal / accomplish feats once thought impossible
cards.eg: With AI-assisted tools, small teams can accomplish in weeks what once required hundreds of workers.

cards.use: make a breakthrough in / a major breakthrough
cards.eg: The lab's breakthrough in battery storage could make electric cars cheaper than petrol ones.

cards.use: an industry burgeons into / burgeon over the past decade
cards.eg: In the past decade, the app economy has burgeoned into one of the city's largest employers.

cards.use: have the capacity to do / build up one's capacity
cards.eg: Today's data centres have the capacity to train models no human team could finish in a lifetime.

cards.use: reach a consensus on / a growing consensus that
cards.eg: There is now a broad consensus that data privacy needs clear global rules.

cards.use: a daunting challenge / daunting though the risks are
cards.eg: Turning a raw idea into a marketable product remains a daunting task for first-time founders.

cards.use: deem sth essential / be deemed impossible
cards.eg: Many economists deem automation the greatest boost to productivity since the assembly line.

cards.zh: 想象，展望（尤指美好的事）
cards.use: envision a future in which / few could have envisioned
cards.eg: Few engineers in the 1980s could have envisioned a world where every phone carries artificial intelligence.

cards.use: evolve from a novelty into a pillar / evolve rapidly
cards.eg: Online shopping has evolved from a curiosity into a pillar of the global economy.

cards.use: an impressive feat / pull off a feat
cards.eg: Landing a rover on Mars is a feat that once seemed the stuff of science fiction.

cards.use: give fresh impetus to / act as an impetus for
cards.eg: The pandemic gave fresh impetus to e-commerce and contactless payment.

cards.use: gather momentum / riding the momentum of
cards.eg: Momentum is building behind green technology as production costs fall year by year.

cards.use: a global phenomenon / a curious phenomenon
cards.eg: The cashless lifestyle is a phenomenon that would have baffled shoppers just twenty years ago.

cards.use: exert a profound influence on / a profound change
cards.eg: Artificial intelligence will exert a profound influence on the way we work.

cards.use: transform the way we do sth / be transformed into
cards.eg: Streaming services transformed the entertainment industry almost overnight.

cards.use: sophisticated consumers / sophisticated algorithms
cards.eg: Sophisticated algorithms now spot financial fraud faster than any human auditor.

cards.use: drive innovation / foster a culture of innovation
cards.eg: Sustained innovation, not cheap labour, is what lifts an economy out of hardship.

cards.use: an ambitious entrepreneur / young entrepreneurs
cards.eg: Every successful entrepreneur has faced the day when the whole project seems doomed to fail.

cards.use: 正文中可缩写为 AI，作主语或定语
cards.eg: Artificial intelligence is moving out of the lab and into factories, hospitals and homes.

cards.use: a recommendation algorithm / train an algorithm
cards.eg: Recommendation algorithms quietly decide what millions of users see each morning.

cards.use: industrial automation / the automation of routine work
cards.eg: Automation has lifted output while forcing the workforce to retrain for new roles.

cards.use: protect intellectual property / intellectual property rights
cards.eg: Strong protection of intellectual property is the bedrock of any innovation-driven economy.

cards.use: 议论文里引用创新排名的权威数据源
cards.eg: Switzerland has topped the Global Innovation Index for more than a decade.

cards.use: a machine learning model，作 AI 的下位概念
cards.eg: Machine learning lets software improve its own performance without being rewritten.

cards.use: spend on research and development / R&D investment
cards.eg: Firms that reinvest profits in research and development steadily outpace their rivals.

cards.use: cross-border e-commerce / the e-commerce sector
cards.eg: E-commerce has turned remote villages into warehouses for the world market.

cards.use: grow the digital economy / a driver of the digital economy
cards.eg: The digital economy now accounts for a considerable share of national output.

cards.use: attract venture capital / a venture capital firm
cards.eg: Startups in tech hubs survive on venture capital until they turn a profit.

cards.use: file a patent / patent protection
cards.eg: A single patent can keep a small research firm afloat for years.

cards.use: 缩写 GDP；论证投入规模时用 as a share of GDP
cards.eg: Many advanced economies now spend over two per cent of GDP on public research each year.

cards.use: 句首作比较状语：as compared to + 名词，主句给出变化数据
cards.eg: As compared to a decade ago, battery prices have plunged by nearly ninety per cent.

cards.use: 对比论证句：in contrast to + 旧事物，主句写新事物
cards.eg: In contrast to traditional factories, smart plants retool their lines within hours.

cards.use: 结论句常用：pay off / benefit sb in the long term
cards.eg: Cutting research budgets saves money today but weakens the economy in the long term.

cards.use: 主语 + reign supreme in + 领域，描述领先地位
cards.eg: For years, a handful of giant platforms have reigned supreme in online retail.

cards.use: 前句摆事实，后接 it is no wonder that 引出结论
cards.eg: One breakthrough followed another all year; it is no wonder that the young team was hailed nationwide.

cards.use: be packed with possibilities / gadgets / crowds
cards.eg: The exhibition hall was packed with gadgets that visionaries had promised for decades.

cards.use: sth speaks to a broad audience / to younger users
cards.eg: Simple design speaks to users of any age, while technical jargon often does not.

cards.use: 让步或结论中平衡观点：for now, ...
cards.eg: For now, regulators favor guiding new technology rather than banning it outright.

cards.use: no assets / nothing / no one other than + 名词
cards.eg: The startup had no assets other than three engineers and a bold idea.

cards.use: 开头背景状语：with the advent of + 技术
cards.eg: With the advent of affordable sensors, homes began collecting data on every habit.

cards.use: 升级 play an important role in
cards.eg: Semiconductors play a pivotal role in everything from phones to power grids.

cards.use: 升级 cause / lead to，主语多为趋势或技术
cards.eg: Cheap computing has given rise to an entire industry of data services.

cards.use: 升级 make sth possible，写因果链条
cards.eg: Open technical standards paved the way for the global app economy.

cards.use: 利弊兼论段的过渡：sth is a double-edged sword
cards.eg: Automation is a double-edged sword: it multiplies output yet displaces drivers and clerks.

cards.zh: 技术变革如此迅速，今日奇观将成明日寻常
cards.en: So rapid is technological change that today's marvels will be tomorrow's routines.
cards.use: So…that 倒装，升级 Technological change is very fast, so...

cards.zh: 真正改变经济的不是机器而是驾驭机器的人
cards.en: It is not the machine but the mind behind it that transforms an economy.
cards.use: 强调句 It is ... that ...，升级 The mind behind the machine transforms an economy.

cards.zh: 竞争对手争相自动化，没有企业敢原地踏步
cards.en: With rivals racing to automate, no firm can afford to stand still.
cards.use: with 复合结构作状语，升级 Because rivals are racing to automate, ...

cards.zh: 在公共资金推动下，基础研究逐步变成改变世界的产品
cards.en: Fueled by public funding, basic research evolved into world-changing products.
cards.use: 过去分词短语作状语，升级 Basic research was funded by the state and evolved into ...

cards.zh: 人们日益达成共识：创新政策必须以人为本
cards.en: There is a growing consensus that innovation policy must put people first.
cards.use: 升级 More and more people think that ...

cards.zh: 一项疗法很可能成为整个行业的转折点
cards.en: A cure for one disease may well prove a turning point for whole industries.
cards.use: may well prove 升级 may become，语气更书面

cards.zh: 软件非但没有让文员失业，反而创造了十年前无人想象的工作
cards.en: Far from putting clerks out of work, software has created jobs no one envisioned a decade ago.
cards.use: Far from + 动名词，升级 Software does not put clerks out of work; instead, it ...

cards.zh: 昔日令人生畏的壮举已成今日的日常
cards.en: What once seemed a daunting feat has become an everyday routine.
cards.use: what 引导主语从句，升级 It used to be difficult, but now it is easy.

cards.zh: 直到规则跟上发明，公众才会真正信任技术
cards.en: Not until rules keep pace with invention will the public truly trust it.
cards.use: Not until 置于句首引发倒装，升级 The public will trust invention only after rules catch up.

cards.zh: 十年爆发式增长的催化剂
cards.en: a catalyst for a decade of explosive growth
cards.use: 名词 catalyst 升级 a cause of / a reason for rapid growth
cards.eg: The first smartphone acted as a catalyst for a decade of explosive growth.

cards.zh: 今天的便利在很大程度上归功于昨天的潜心研究
cards.en: Today's convenience owes a great deal to yesterday's patient research.
cards.use: owe ... to ... 归因句型，升级 ... because of yesterday's research

cards.zh: 站在新创新浪潮的最前沿
cards.en: at the forefront of the new wave of innovation
cards.use: 升级 leading in innovation / in the front
cards.eg: Research universities sit at the forefront of the new wave of innovation.

cards.zh: 我们正亲历一场悄然改写日常生活规则的技术革命。
cards.en: We are living through a technological revolution that is quietly rewriting the rules of daily life.
cards.use: 开头点题句

cards.zh: 过去十年创新势头如此之强，普通家庭的消费方式已面目一新。
cards.en: Innovation has gathered such momentum in the past decade that the way ordinary families spend money is barely recognizable.
cards.use: 背景趋势句，such...that 结果句

cards.zh: 试举一例：人工智能如今能在人眼察觉之前就标记出疾病。
cards.en: A case in point is artificial intelligence, which now flags diseases years before a tired human eye can.
cards.use: 举例句，A case in point is ...

cards.zh: 硅谷的崛起表明，一次突破就足以在一夜之间改变整个行业。
cards.en: The rise of Silicon Valley shows that a single breakthrough can transform an entire sector almost overnight.
cards.use: 举例句，引用本单元专有名词

cards.zh: 与集市货摊不同，电商平台不拥有一家店铺也能服务数百万顾客。
cards.en: In contrast to a market stall, an e-commerce platform can serve millions of customers without owning a single shop.
cards.use: 对比论证句，复用词表短语 in contrast to

cards.zh: 与十年前相比，如今的年轻人是更懂技术也更没耐心的消费者。
cards.en: As compared to a decade ago, today's youngsters are far savvier and far less patient consumers.
cards.use: 比较句，复用词表短语 as compared to

cards.zh: 在持续创新的推动下，该行业连续三年以每年百分之十增长。
cards.en: Fueled by relentless innovation, the sector has grown by ten per cent per annum for three consecutive years.
cards.use: 因果句，分词状语开头

cards.zh: 对研发的巨额投入为小作坊成为行业枢纽注入了动力。
cards.en: A considerable investment in research and development gave the small workshop the impetus to become an industry hub.
cards.use: 因果句，impetus / hub 为本单元词表词

cards.zh: 尽管风险令人却步，暂停创新绝非蓄势待发之国的选项。
cards.en: Daunting though the risks may be, pausing innovation is not an option for a nation poised for progress.
cards.use: 让步句，形容词提前倒装，转折引出立场

cards.zh: 人工智能专利多于其他任何领域，难怪它在最新全球创新指数中独冠群雄。
cards.en: AI patents outnumber those in every other field; it is no wonder that artificial intelligence reigns supreme in the latest Global Innovation Index.
cards.use: 用 no wonder that 收束论据得出结论

cards.zh: 长远来看，创新的成果不以新奇论高下，而以其惠及人群的广狭来衡量。
cards.en: In the long term, the fruits of innovation will be measured not by their novelty but by how widely they are shared.
cards.use: 结论句，not by ... but by ... 对称结构

cards.zh: 唯有让创造力与责任同行，我们才能确保技术服务于人类而非相反。
cards.en: Only by pairing creativity with responsibility can we make sure that technology serves humanity rather than the reverse.
cards.use: 结尾倡议句，Only by ... 引发倒装
roam the cobbled streets / roam freely，写远足见闻的首选动词
cards.eg: On my first morning in Copenhagen I simply roamed the cobbled streets beside the harbour, following no map at all.

cards.use: cherish a memory / cherish local traditions，观点句与结论段常用
cards.eg: We should cherish the quiet villages before crowds and commerce change them for good.

cards.zh: 持久的；经得起时间考验的
cards.use: an enduring appeal / enduring value，常与 charm, influence 搭配
cards.eg: Fossils have an enduring power: they make us feel how short a single life is.

cards.use: vt. charm visitors / n. the charm of an old town
cards.eg: The charm of a small city often lies in things no guidebook thinks worth listing.

cards.use: grasp why... / come to a grasp of，写旅行所得
cards.eg: Only after walking the same path did I begin to grasp why the poet loved these hills.

cards.use: an impulse to travel / out of impulse，起因段用
cards.eg: Booking that ticket was pure impulse, and the trip turned out to be the best I have ever taken.

cards.use: the transition from A to B，写城市到乡野的心态变化
cards.eg: Hiking forces a slow transition from the noise of the city to the rhythms of the countryside.

cards.use: maximize the benefit of a journey，与 minimize 对举
cards.eg: Backpackers often stay two nights in one town to maximize what they can learn about it.

cards.use: endanger wildlife / endanger local culture，问题段
cards.eg: Feeding wild goats near the trail may seem kind, but it endangers both the animals and the hikers who come too close.

cards.use: be ignorant of local customs / tourists ignorant of...
cards.eg: Tourists ignorant of local customs often mistake a quiet village for an empty one.

cards.use: a casual conversation / a casual glance，写偶遇
cards.eg: A casual conversation with a chambermaid in Oslo taught me more about the city than any museum had.

cards.use: a thoughtful traveler / a thoughtful account，建议段
cards.eg: A thoughtful traveler thinks about the footprint a trip leaves behind as well as the photographs it produces.

cards.use: be passionate about sth.，写兴趣与志向
cards.eg: She became so passionate about fossils that every weekend found her on a different riverbank.

cards.use: sketch a scene / a rough sketch of，替换 draw
cards.eg: He stopped every hour to sketch a birch or a roofline, and the walk quietly became a lesson in looking.

cards.use: a snapshot of daily life，比喻用法比本义更出彩
cards.eg: The night market in Ho Chi Minh City is a snapshot of how ordinary people feed a city of ten million.

cards.zh: 未经过滤的；原汁原味的
cards.use: unfiltered reality / an unfiltered picture，对比社交媒体
cards.eg: Living with a family in a Russian village for a week gives you an unfiltered picture that no tour bus can offer.

cards.use: travel / landscape photography，讨论拍照与体验之争
cards.eg: Landscape photography made this muddy valley famous, although few visitors ever look closely at the rocks themselves.

cards.use: scramble up a rocky slope，远足叙事的动作词
cards.eg: We scrambled up the last slope as the fog lifted, and the whole valley opened out beneath us.

cards.use: fossil beds / a fossil of...，自然与时间话题的论据
cards.eg: In Oregon, fossils of ancient forests lie preserved in layers of hardened volcanic ash.

cards.use: the fossil record shows...，论证深时与变迁
cards.eg: The fossil record at John Day preserves, layer by layer, tens of millions of years of climate change.

cards.use: read the layers / laid down over centuries，比 rock 更正式
cards.eg: Each geological layer on the cliff marks a different age, and together they read like a diary of the earth.

cards.use: protected as a national monument，谈保护与开发
cards.eg: Because the site is managed as a national monument, visitors may photograph the fossils but may not take them home.

cards.use: a shared natural heritage，升华段的世界视角
cards.eg: The loss of one species is a wound to the natural heritage of the whole planet.

cards.use: safeguard cultural heritage，与 natural heritage 对举
cards.eg: The old quarter of a city like Vidin is cultural heritage; once demolished, it cannot be rebuilt.

cards.use: the preservation of old towns，比 protection 更专指原物留存
cards.eg: The preservation of the windmill cost less than a replica would and kept its original timber.

cards.use: develop / earn a living through ecotourism，解决方案段
cards.eg: Villages beside the monument now earn a living through ecotourism rather than cutting timber.

cards.use: exceed the carrying capacity of...，论证过度旅游
cards.eg: When daily visitors exceed the carrying capacity of the trail, the meadow beside it begins to die.

cards.use: a model of sustainable tourism，结论段关键词
cards.eg: Sustainable tourism means that a town can welcome a million guests a year without losing the character that drew them.

cards.use: cut / leave a smaller carbon footprint，交通方式对比
cards.eg: A night train leaves a far smaller carbon footprint than the same journey made by plane.

cards.use: the commercialization of historic streets，批判段
cards.eg: The commercialization of the old quarter turned family workshops into shops selling identical souvenirs.

cards.en: as far as I am concerned
cards.use: 开头亮观点，替换 I think；sb. 可换成 he / they
cards.eg: As far as I am concerned, a weekend in the hills does more for a tired student than a week at the seaside.

cards.use: bring back memories / bring back stories，由景生情
cards.eg: The smell of chestnuts roasting beside a roadside stall in Russia brought back my childhood winters.

cards.zh: 步某人的后尘；继承其事业
cards.use: follow in a parent's / a teacher's footsteps，写传承
cards.eg: Her grandfather walked these trails for forty years, and now she is following in his footsteps as a park guide.

cards.use: word / news got around，写秘境被游客发现
cards.eg: News of the fossil find soon got around, and a road that had been empty for a decade began to fill with cars.

cards.use: a plan / a project gets off the ground，建议与成效段
cards.eg: The village's first hiking festival finally got off the ground, thanks to two retired teachers and a borrowed tent.

cards.use: get the hang of doing sth.，写学习过程与适应期
cards.eg: It took me two days to get the hang of reading the layers in the cliff; after that, the rocks seemed to talk.

cards.use: watch / identify sth. in real time，写科技与导览
cards.eg: The guide used an app that identified each fossil in real time, so even small children felt like researchers.

cards.use: 结尾收束，替换 finally，语气更有总结感
cards.eg: We argued over the map for an hour, and in the end the farmer we asked simply walked us to the gate.

cards.use: stumble upon a place / a fact，远足叙事首选
cards.eg: Rounding a bend in the French hills, I stumbled upon a stone farmhouse that appeared on no map.

cards.use: 否定类比，替换 not at all，论证更锋利
cards.eg: A snapshot is no more a journey than a menu is a meal.

cards.use: a taxi pulled up beside us，叙事转场用
cards.eg: A pickup truck pulled up beside us, and the driver offered to carry our packs to the next town.

cards.use: 旅行收益段的必用搭配，替换 make one know more
cards.eg: Walking alone through unfamiliar streets broadened my horizons more than any textbook did.

cards.use: 替换 experience the local culture，主语性数要一致
cards.eg: She rented a room above a bakery, immersed herself in local life, and learned more in a week than in a semester.

cards.zh: 远离人迹的；不落俗套的
cards.use: 写小众旅行，替换 in a remote place
cards.eg: Our guide took us off the beaten track, to a village whose only road is a mule path along the river.

cards.use: 升级 a lucky accident / by chance，旅行类高分词
cards.eg: The best find of the trip was pure serendipity: we took the wrong turning and met a festival we had never heard of.

cards.use: 升级 walk slowly without a plan；小路、河流皆可作主语
cards.eg: We let the path meander up through the birches and stopped worrying about the clock.

cards.use: 升级 very old / with a long history，形容名城与手艺
cards.eg: In a time-honored bookshop by Oslo's harbour, the owner still repairs bindings by hand.

cards.use: 升级 very beautiful / wonderful，写自然景观
cards.eg: The scar left by the mudflow is awe-inspiring in the way that all old disasters are: silent and enormous.

cards.use: 升级 attract many visitors / interest people
cards.eg: Few things captivate a child as completely as a stone that was once a leaf.

cards.use: 升级 a detail that shows...，举例论证时引出证据
cards.eg: The worn stone step at the door is a telling detail: for three centuries the same families have walked in and out.

cards.use: 升级 almost，常接 impossible / cut off / unknown
cards.eg: After the last bus left, the valley was virtually cut off from the outside world.

cards.zh: （否定倒装）游客与行者看到的从不是同一条街
cards.en: Rarely do tourists and travelers see the same street.
cards.use: 句首否定倒装，升级 Tourists and travelers rarely see the same street.
cards.eg: Rarely do we understand a foreign custom until we have to live by it.

cards.zh: （分词状语）小路穿过桦林，终于通到山脊
cards.en: Winding through the birches, the path finally opens onto the ridge.
cards.use: 分词作状语，升级 The path winds through the birches and it finally opens onto the ridge.
cards.eg: Tucked between two hills, the village sleeps through most of the tourist season.

cards.zh: （with 复合结构）火山灰层层封存五千万年
cards.en: with layers of volcanic ash holding millions of years of history
cards.use: with 复合结构，升级 and there are layers of ash that hold...，描写地貌
cards.eg: We stood there with the sun dropping and the ancient sea floor glowing at our feet.

cards.zh: （as 让步倒装）化石虽惊人，多数游客却匆匆走过
cards.en: Striking as the fossil beds are, most visitors hurry past them.
cards.use: 让步倒装，升级 Although the fossil beds are striking, most visitors hurry past them.
cards.eg: Lonely as the trail was, none of us wanted to turn back before the summit.

cards.zh: （强调句）改变我们的是行走而非抵达
cards.en: It is the walking, not the arriving, that changes us.
cards.use: 强调句型，升级 Walking changes us more than arriving does，结尾点题
cards.eg: It was the chambermaid's quiet pride that I remembered longest.

cards.zh: 旅行从地图结束、脚步开始的地方起步。
cards.en: Travel begins where the map ends and the walking starts.
cards.use: 首段点题句；可用同类句式改写主题词

cards.zh: 越来越多的年轻人放弃拥挤的旅游大巴，改选穿越乡间的慢速徒步。
cards.en: More and more young people are trading crowded tour buses for slow hikes through the countryside.
cards.use: 现象背景句，用于首段引出话题

cards.zh: 就我而言，以脚步丈量的旅程比以照片丈量的旅程更能教人。
cards.en: As far as I am concerned, a journey measured in footsteps teaches more than one measured in photographs.
cards.use: 观点句，首段末或第二段开头

cards.zh: 在俄勒冈的克拉诺区，火山灰层仍保存着亚热带森林的化石，游人读它如读页面。
cards.en: In the Clarno Unit of Oregon, layers of volcanic ash still hold fossils of subtropical forests, and visitors read them like pages.
cards.use: 举例段：用具体地点与细节支撑论点

cards.zh: 正如一位旅行者所写，旅行最好的纪念品是看待自家街道的全新眼光。
cards.en: As one traveler wrote, 'the best souvenir of a journey is a new way of seeing your own street.'
cards.use: 引言句，作题记或论证的收束引用

cards.zh: 游客从车窗拍下大教堂，步行者却留意到六个世纪前刻进石头里的石匠标记。
cards.en: Tourists photograph a cathedral from the coach window, while walkers notice the mason's mark cut into its stone six centuries ago.
cards.use: 对比论证句，while 连接两侧

cards.zh: 正因村子远离主干道，它的方言、烤炉与旧日礼节能存续过去五十年。
cards.en: Because the village lies off the main road, its dialect, its bread ovens and its old manners have survived the past fifty years.
cards.use: 因果论证句，解释现象成因

cards.zh: 旅游虽给历史小城带来钱财，人流却可能磨蚀吸引他们前来的街道本身。
cards.en: Although tourism brings money to historic towns, the crowds may wear down the very streets that draw them there.
cards.use: 让步句，双面分析段的首句

cards.zh: 在哥本哈根，近半数通勤仍靠自行车完成，每日上班路本身就是一堂可持续的课。
cards.en: In Copenhagen, where nearly half of all commutes are made by bicycle, the daily journey to work is itself a lesson in sustainability.
cards.use: 事实例证句，用名城作论据

cards.zh: 我在荷兰一座村庄外偶然遇见了一座任何旅游手册都不曾提到的风车。
cards.en: I stumbled upon a windmill outside a village in the Netherlands, and no guidebook had ever mentioned it.
cards.use: 记叙句，个人经历段

cards.zh: 若想让本土文化延续，就该珍视每座城市的独特，而不是把每条街都变成礼品店。
cards.en: If we want local culture to endure, we should cherish what makes each city different rather than turning every street into a gift shop.
cards.use: 建议句，措施段或倒数第二段

cards.zh: 最终，旅行教会我们对别处的生活保持好奇，并小心不将其毁坏。
cards.en: In the end, travel teaches us to be curious about other lives and careful not to damage them.
cards.use: 结论升华句，末段收束
addiction to shopping / social media addiction
cards.eg: Shopping addiction drives many consumers to run out of savings long before payday.

cards.use: disposable income / a throwaway, disposable mindset
cards.eg: A disposable mindset fills landfills and leaves people feeling just as empty as the products they toss.

cards.use: a discontented workforce / feel discontented with
cards.eg: Even well-paid employees grow discontented when long hours leave no room for family or rest.

cards.use: a constant distraction / digital distractions
cards.eg: Every notification is a tiny distraction that pulls attention away from deep, fulfilling work.

cards.use: the duality of modern life / material and spiritual duality
cards.eg: The duality of prosperity and anxiety defines our age: wealth has grown, yet contentment has not.

cards.use: enhance well-being / enhance the quality of life
cards.eg: Brief walks in nature can enhance mood far more effectively than another round of online shopping.

cards.use: a sense of fulfillment / find fulfillment in
cards.eg: Volunteers often report a deeper sense of fulfillment than they do on promotion day.

cards.use: the fragility of happiness / emotional fragility
cards.eg: A recession exposes the fragility of lifestyles built entirely on borrowed income.

cards.use: make happiness accessible / accessible to all
cards.eg: Meditation apps have made mindfulness techniques accessible to people who once dismissed them as luxuries.

cards.use: an inevitable consequence / it is inevitable that
cards.eg: Stress is an inevitable part of ambition, but chronic burnout is not.

cards.use: tempt consumers into / be tempted to do
cards.eg: Flash-sale ads tempt even frugal shoppers into buying items they had planned to resist.

cards.use: tackle the root causes of / tackle a problem
cards.eg: Schools that teach mindfulness help teenagers tackle exam pressure before it becomes unbearable.

cards.use: material prosperity / a barrier to prosperity
cards.eg: National prosperity no longer measures only GDP; it also counts how freely citizens pursue what fulfills them.

cards.use: sacrifice productivity / a productivity-obsessed culture
cards.eg: A productivity-obsessed culture quietly ruins health by treating every idle minute as wasted time.

cards.use: the wealthy / ever-wealthy consumers
cards.eg: Wealthy suburbs show no immunity to the same anxiety that grips lower-income neighbourhoods.

cards.use: resist the urge to / resist temptation
cards.eg: Most people find it hard to resist the urge to check their phones within seconds of a buzz.

cards.use: equate happiness with success / be wrongly equated with
cards.eg: When people equate self-worth with a paycheck, every setback feels like a personal failure.

cards.use: overcome a hurdle / a major hurdle to well-being
cards.eg: The hardest hurdle for young graduates is standing on their own feet while the job market shrinks.

cards.use: consumer materialism / a culture of materialism
cards.eg: Psychologists link higher materialism to lower life satisfaction across dozens of cultures.

cards.use: the pursuit of instant gratification
cards.eg: Streaming and same-day delivery feed a habit of instant gratification that erodes patience and depth.

cards.use: maintain a healthy work-life balance
cards.eg: Companies that enforce true work-life balance see lower turnover and higher productivity.

cards.use: go on a digital detox
cards.eg: A weekend digital detox helped her rediscover the meditative calm that scrolling had stolen.

cards.use: stuck on the hedonic treadmill
cards.eg: The more we buy, the faster we run on the hedonic treadmill without ever gaining lasting joy.

cards.use: critique consumer culture
cards.eg: Consumer culture persuades us to equate a fuller life with a fuller shopping cart.

cards.use: research on subjective well-being
cards.eg: Surveys of subjective well-being suggest that strong social bonds matter more than any pay rise.

cards.use: suffer from chronic burnout
cards.eg: Chronic burnout is not a badge of honour but a signal that boundaries have collapsed.

cards.use: fuelled by status anxiety
cards.eg: Status anxiety drives young professionals to sacrifice sleep for titles they never truly wanted.

cards.use: embrace slow living
cards.eg: The slow living movement argues that a richer life comes from fewer, deeper commitments.

cards.use: pursue self-actualization
cards.eg: Once basic security is met, people naturally look to self-actualization for lasting fulfillment.

cards.use: hit the point of diminishing returns
cards.eg: Beyond a certain income, each extra dollar brings diminishing returns to happiness.

cards.use: stay home by choice / live simply by choice — 对比 not by choice
cards.eg: Few workers endure eighty-hour weeks by choice; most do so because rent leaves them no alternative.

cards.use: by nature social / by nature restless — 描述人性本论
cards.eg: Humans are by nature social creatures, yet modern routines isolate us more than any plague once did.

cards.en: have a hard time doing sth.
cards.use: have a hard time relaxing / focusing / sleeping
cards.eg: Overworked students often have a hard time distinguishing genuine curiosity from exam-driven panic.

cards.use: pressure leads people to compromise / this leads consumers to overspend
cards.eg: Endless comparison on social media leads many young people to chase careers that never fulfill them.

cards.zh: 继续前行；转向新的方向
cards.use: move on from failure / move on to the next stage
cards.eg: A lost job is a bump in the road, not a wall; learning to move on preserves mental health.

cards.use: run out of energy / patience / savings
cards.eg: By the fifth consecutive deadline, she had run out of both sleep and optimism.

cards.use: learn to stand on one's own feet — 青年话题常用
cards.eg: Graduates who stand on their own feet report higher fulfillment than those shielded by family wealth.

cards.use: treat failure as a bump in the road — 让步或安慰语境
cards.eg: A single recession is a bump in the road for a society that values well-being over mere GDP growth.

cards.use: at the expense of health / family / happiness
cards.eg: Climbing the corporate ladder at the expense of sleep and friendship rarely brings peace.

cards.use: in the pursuit of happiness / wealth — 议论文万能框架
cards.eg: In the pursuit of happiness, people often overlook the small, accessible joys already around them.

cards.use: at the mercy of algorithms / the market
cards.eg: Freelancers live at the mercy of the next contract, which keeps anxiety permanently in the background.

cards.use: well-being should take precedence over profit
cards.eg: In a humane workplace, mental health must take precedence over quarterly output targets.

cards.use: break free from the cycle of consumption
cards.eg: She decided to break free from the habit of buying comfort goods and started journaling instead.

cards.use: look to sb. for comfort / look to spirituality — 本单元词表
cards.eg: When material life fails to console them, many young people look to meditation and community for peace.

cards.use: 替换 harm / damage / make ... weaker
cards.eg: Constant comparison with strangers online can quietly undermine a person's satisfaction with ordinary life.

cards.en: Only by redefining success can society escape the hedonic treadmill.
cards.use: 升级 'Society can escape the hedonic treadmill only by redefining success'
cards.eg: Only by redefining success can a generation born into consumption learn to find fulfillment elsewhere.

cards.en: Far from bringing satisfaction, relentless buying quietly corrodes the peace it promises.
cards.use: 升级 'Relentless buying does not bring satisfaction; instead it corrodes peace'
cards.eg: Far from relieving stress, endless scrolling often intensifies the discontent it was supposed to cure.

cards.zh: With + 名词 + 分词（独立主格）
cards.en: With material needs met yet inner voids widening, a growing number of people feel oddly hollow.
cards.use: 升级 'Although material needs are met, inner voids widen, so many feel hollow'
cards.eg: With wages rising but hours lengthening, young workers find themselves earning more and living less.

cards.en: What fuels the modern consumer's discontent is not scarcity but endless comparison.
cards.use: 升级 'Endless comparison, not scarcity, fuels the modern consumer's discontent'
cards.eg: What makes burnout unbearable is not the workload itself but the silence around it.

cards.en: the paradox that prosperity coexists with pervasive anxiety
cards.use: 升级 'the contradiction that people are rich but anxious'
cards.eg: The paradox that prosperity coexists with pervasive anxiety has challenged economists for decades.

cards.en: It is consumer culture itself, rather than any personal failing, that traps us on the hedonic treadmill.
cards.use: 升级 'Consumer culture, not personal failing, traps us'
cards.eg: It is the relentless pace of work, not a lack of discipline, that deprives people of restorative leisure.

cards.en: Battered by deadlines and bills alike, young professionals often have a hard time finding inner stillness.
cards.use: 升级 'Young professionals are battered by deadlines and bills, and they struggle to find inner stillness'
cards.eg: Raised amid constant competition, this generation equates rest with losing ground.

cards.zh: a growing proportion of（升级 many people）
cards.use: 替换 more and more people / an increasing number of people
cards.eg: A growing proportion of city dwellers now treat weekend hikes as a form of digital detox.

cards.zh: indispensable to（升级 very important for）
cards.use: 替换 very important for / essential to
cards.eg: A sense of purpose is indispensable to lasting happiness; no amount of money can substitute for it.

cards.use: 替换 harmful / damaging / bad for
cards.eg: Sleep deprivation proves detrimental not only to productivity but to emotional resilience.

cards.zh: Hard-pressed as sb. may be…（让步倒装）
cards.en: Hard-pressed as they are by rent and loans, many young people still refuse to trade meaning for a higher paycheck.
cards.use: 升级 'Although they are hard-pressed by rent and loans, many young people still...'
cards.eg: Hard-pressed as she was by overtime demands, she carved out an hour each evening for painting.

cards.zh: 在物质空前丰富的时代，幸福感反而成了人们热议却难解的难题。
cards.en: In an era of unprecedented material abundance, happiness has paradoxically become the most debated and least understood problem of daily life.
cards.use: 开头段·点题（unprecedented, paradoxically 增强对比）

cards.zh: 对财富的无尽追求往往导致年轻人将幸福等同于消费能力。
cards.en: The relentless pursuit of wealth often leads young people to equate happiness with their capacity to consume.
cards.use: 因果段·论述核心问题（lead sb. to do + equate A with B）

cards.zh: 尽管繁荣让数亿人摆脱了贫困，一种挥之不去的不满却在最富裕的社会里蔓延。
cards.en: While prosperity has lifted millions out of poverty, a creeping discontent has spread through the very wealthiest societies.
cards.use: 对比段·让步（While 引导，凸显 duality）

cards.zh: 一个典型的例子是所谓的996工作文化，它让从业者几乎没有时间放松或陪伴家人。
cards.en: A case in point is the so-called 996 work culture, where practitioners have a hard time finding even one hour for rest or family.
cards.use: 举例段·具体例证（A case in point is… + have a hard time doing）

cards.zh: 诚然，经济保障对幸福感不可或缺，但它绝不能以健康和人际关系为代价。
cards.en: Admittedly, financial security is indispensable to well-being; it must never, however, come at the expense of health or relationships.
cards.use: 让步+观点段·辩证（Admittedly… however 让步框架）

cards.zh: 唯有重新定义成功，社会才能让个体摆脱那条永远奔跑却原地踏步的幸福跑步机。
cards.en: Only by redefining success can a society free its citizens from a hedonic treadmill on which running faster means staying exactly where they are.
cards.use: 结论段·升华（Only by… 倒装 + 定语从句）

cards.zh: 当人们把自我价值等同于工资单上的数字时，每一次拒绝都成了对人格的否定。
cards.en: When people equate their self-worth with the figure on a paycheck, every rejection becomes a verdict on who they are.
cards.use: 因果段·心理分析（equate…with + every…becomes 概括）

cards.zh: 研究表明，那些选择简朴生活而非炫耀性消费的人往往报告出更高的充实感。
cards.en: Research indicates that individuals who choose simplicity over conspicuous consumption consistently report a deeper sense of fulfillment.
cards.use: 论据段·引用数据或研究（Research indicates that…）

cards.zh: 在快节奏生活的压力下，一次数字断舍离或许并非奢侈而是维系心智的必需。
cards.en: Under the relentless pressure of a fast-paced life, a digital detox may be less a luxury than a necessity for preserving mental clarity.
cards.use: 建议段·提出对策（less a…than a… 并列否定强调）

cards.zh: 正如一句谚语所言：金钱能买到舒适，却买不到那种唯有热爱和归属才能带来的宁静。
cards.en: As the saying goes, money can purchase comfort but never the quiet that only passion and belonging can bestow.
cards.use: 举例或结论段·引用谚语增强说服力（As the saying goes…）

cards.zh: 物质带来的愉悦稍纵即逝，而精神上的满足——无论是创造、学习还是关爱——则历久弥新。
cards.en: Pleasure drawn from possessions evaporates almost as quickly as it arrives, whereas spiritual fulfillment, born of creating, learning, or caring, deepens with time.
cards.use: 对比段·核心论点（whereas + born of 分词）

cards.zh: 因此，政策制定者在衡量繁荣时若只盯着经济指标而忽视主观幸福感，便无法回应人民内心真正的渴望。
cards.en: Therefore, policymakers who measure prosperity solely through economic indicators while ignoring subjective well-being fail to answer the deepest longings of their people.
cards.use: 结论段·呼吁行动（Therefore + who 定语 + fail to）
cultural bias / unconscious bias，指媒体、教材中的倾向性
cards.eg: Textbooks still show a bias toward naming men when they describe discovery and public life.

cards.use: gender discrimination / employment discrimination，多用于问题段
cards.eg: Legal reform alone cannot end discrimination that is woven into ordinary routines.

cards.use: cultural heritage / safeguard a region's heritage
cards.eg: The villagers treat their irrigation canals as heritage rather than as an obstacle to new roads.

cards.zh: 继承（财产、传统）；经遗传获得
cards.use: inherit a tradition / inherit assumptions，可用于文化传承段
cards.eg: We inherit not only our ancestors' property but also their unexamined beliefs.

cards.use: identify A as B / identify with，身份认同话题高频
cards.eg: Teenagers readily identify with fictional characters who defy the roles assigned to them.

cards.use: an instinctive reaction / instinctive behaviour，反驳天性论时用
cards.eg: Caregiving was long called instinctive, although every generation must be taught how to do it.

cards.use: gender inequality / widening inequality
cards.eg: Inequality appears not only in pay but in who is expected to work without pay.

cards.use: draw a generalization from / an over-broad generalization，让步段常用
cards.eg: One memorable story can tempt a writer into a generalization that the data cannot support.

cards.use: break a stereotype / challenge a stereotype
cards.eg: A stereotype survives because repeating it is cheaper than testing it.

cards.use: public discourse / shape the discourse on family life
cards.eg: The public discourse on marriage has shifted from duty to mutual care.

cards.use: 作论据来源：an anthropologist argues / fieldwork evidence
cards.eg: The anthropologist lived in the village for two years before drawing any conclusion about its rituals.

cards.zh: 以实验（或经验）为依据的；实证的
cards.use: empirical evidence / an empirical study，用于加强论证可信度
cards.eg: Her claim rests on empirical findings rather than on intuition about how people behave.

cards.use: gender equality / the gender gap，本单元核心主语
cards.eg: Gender helps determine how much free time a person has, not only which job she holds.

cards.zh: （许多人相信的）错误观念；荒诞说法
cards.use: dispel a myth / the myth that ...，开头批驳式立意
cards.eg: The myth that boys outperform girls in mathematics collapses wherever girls are taught first.

cards.use: a tendency to do sth / a growing tendency toward
cards.eg: There is a tendency to explain away discrimination as nothing more than personal preference.

cards.use: a personality trait / traits attributed to one sex
cards.eg: Few traits are evenly split between the sexes, and none defines either sex entirely.

cards.use: the validity of a claim / question the validity of a tradition
cards.eg: The validity of a custom should be judged by whether it still serves the people who keep it.

cards.use: political representation / the representation of women in the media
cards.eg: A committee that mirrors the public is a matter of representation, not of courtesy.

cards.zh: 性别角色（社会期待的行为模式）
cards.use: rigid gender roles / conform to traditional gender roles
cards.eg: Children acquire gender roles from toys and classroom routines long before anyone lectures them.

cards.use: challenge a gender stereotype，比单个 stereotype 更正式
cards.eg: Challenging a gender stereotype in the classroom begins with counting who gets called on.

cards.zh: 父权制；男性主导的社会结构
cards.use: a patriarchal family / patriarchal authority，学术化表述
cards.eg: Patriarchy endures less through force than through habits everyone has learned to call natural.

cards.zh: 内隐偏见；无意识的偏好
cards.use: reduce / curb implicit bias，对应本单元 unconscious 概念
cards.eg: Hiring panels can curb implicit bias by reviewing applications with the names removed.

cards.zh: 系统性歧视（制度层面的歧视）
cards.use: expose systemic discrimination，比 individual bias 更有力
cards.eg: When identical applications succeed under a male name, the fault is systemic rather than personal.

cards.use: narrow / close the gender pay gap，数据例证常配
cards.eg: The gender pay gap widens fastest in the years when a couple's first child arrives.

cards.zh: 玻璃天花板（无形的晋升壁垒）
cards.use: break through the glass ceiling，比喻性术语
cards.eg: In several industries the executive suite remains the final floor of the glass ceiling.

cards.use: safeguard / list intangible cultural heritage，遗产话题必备
cards.eg: Inscribing the craft as intangible cultural heritage commits the state to keeping it alive.

cards.use: shape / strengthen one's cultural identity
cards.eg: Migrant children often rebuild their cultural identity from the festivals their grandparents refuse to abandon.

cards.zh: 集体记忆（群体共享的历史印象）
cards.use: shape collective memory / sites of collective memory
cards.eg: Monuments shape collective memory, which is why quarrels over them are never only about stone.

cards.zh: 文化同化（融入主流而丧失自身特征）
cards.use: pressure toward cultural assimilation，与 heritage 对比使用
cards.eg: Cultural assimilation once promised belonging while quietly demanding that minority children abandon their language.

cards.zh: 社会流动性（阶层上下流动的可能）
cards.use: upward social mobility / education as a ladder of mobility
cards.eg: Public libraries offered the only dependable ladder of social mobility in towns built around a single mine.

cards.use: apply to sb / The rule applies to both sexes.
cards.eg: Arguments about talent apply to every field, yet we invoke them mainly about women.

cards.use: 多后置：careers at stake / so much is at stake
cards.eg: When a daughter's inheritance is at stake, a family's openness to change is truly tested.

cards.use: keep policy in line with principle / bring A in line with B
cards.eg: Parental leave for fathers brings workplace rules in line with how families actually live.

cards.use: 比较维度：in terms of income / time / access
cards.eg: In terms of unpaid housework, the gap between the sexes has barely moved in two decades.

cards.zh: 开始受人瞩目；崭露头角
cards.use: rise to prominence as / under，写人物或群体的崛起
cards.eg: Several women novelists rose to prominence under male pen names, since publishers assumed a woman's name would sell fewer copies.

cards.use: 正式过渡：with respect to education / access
cards.eg: With respect to school access, the difference between rural boys and rural girls has narrowed sharply.

cards.use: preserve / defend sth at all costs；相关框架 at the cost of
cards.eg: No tradition deserves to be preserved at all costs, for some customs survive only by silencing those they harm.

cards.use: 因果分析首选：prejudice stems from ...
cards.eg: Much modern bias stems from job descriptions written for a household that no longer exists.

cards.zh: 使……受到质疑，动摇……的可信度
cards.use: call sth into question / be called into question，升级 doubt
cards.eg: Years of fieldwork have called into question the old idea that caregiving is a woman's instinct.

cards.use: strike a balance between A and B：传统与现代、保护与利用
cards.eg: Old cities must strike a balance between preserving their heritage and meeting the needs of the living.

cards.use: 论证评价：a claim / custom stands up to scrutiny
cards.eg: Few inherited hierarchies stand up to scrutiny once outsiders are allowed to ask why.

cards.use: narrow the gap between A and B，对策段常用
cards.eg: Affordable childcare narrows the gap between what women are hired for and what they are trained for.

cards.use: shape public attitudes toward difference / ageing，升级 influence
cards.eg: Commercials shape attitudes toward women more quietly than any statute changes them.

cards.use: hand sth down to sb；被动亦可：customs handed down for centuries
cards.eg: Grandmothers hand down recipes whose proportions exist nowhere but in memory.

cards.zh: 使（不良现象）延续、使永存
cards.use: 升级 keep up / pass on：perpetuate stereotypes / inequality
cards.eg: Advertising that shows only mothers tidying perpetuates a rule no legislature ever wrote.

cards.zh: 根深蒂固的，难以动摇的
cards.use: 升级 deep-rooted / firmly fixed：entrenched attitudes
cards.eg: Decades of custom left entrenched patterns that one directive cannot unravel.

cards.zh: 使边缘化，使处于无关紧要的地位
cards.use: 升级 push aside / treat as unimportant：marginalize rural workers
cards.eg: A city that plans only for commuters marginalizes everyone who cannot travel at peak hours.

cards.use: 升级 show / stress：data underscore the point
cards.eg: The ministry's own figures underscore the point its spokesperson declined to make.

cards.zh: 逐步拆除、废除（制度、壁垒）
cards.use: 升级 remove / break down：dismantle barriers
cards.eg: Dismantling formal barriers is quicker than dismantling the customs that outlive them.

cards.use: 升级 put down to / blame on，语气更书面
cards.eg: We ascribe the pay difference to free choice, rarely asking who was taught to choose modestly.

cards.zh: 同位语或插入语补充说明，合并两个短句
cards.en: Anthropologists, who spend years inside the communities they study, keep finding change where outsiders expected permanence.
cards.use: 升级两个简单句并列：插入语交代身份，再给结论
cards.eg: George Eliot, the pen name of Mary Ann Evans, was assumed for years to belong to a man.

cards.en: It is the household ledger, not the marriage vow, that reveals who really decides.
cards.use: 升级普通主谓句：用强调句凸显真正原因
cards.eg: It was not talent but access that raised one generation of women into the professions.

cards.zh: 否定词置于句首引起部分倒装，加强论断
cards.en: Rarely has a prejudice survived the day it was named aloud.
cards.use: 升级 Seldom / Hardly 开头的正常语序句
cards.eg: Not until the 1970s did historians begin to treat ordinary households as evidence.

cards.zh: 过去分词短语作状语，替代原因从句
cards.en: Raised on tales of female passivity, girls learn discretion before they learn ambition.
cards.use: 升级 because 从句：句首分词给背景，主句给后果
cards.eg: Loaded with unpaid work after dark, many caregivers never attend the meetings where decisions are made.

cards.zh: 表伴随或原因的复合状语，凝练背景信息
cards.en: With so much heritage at stake, silence is itself a decision.
cards.use: with + 名词 + 补语：升级 because / while 从句
cards.eg: With the candidate list drawn from one half of the population, the result cannot claim to represent both.

cards.en: Startling as the statistics look, they persuade only once we explain what they measure.
cards.use: 升级 Although the statistics are startling，倒装更凝练
cards.eg: Ancient as the custom is, it cannot claim authority merely by age.

cards.zh: 性别平等与其说是立法问题，不如说是日常文化中根深蒂固的假设问题。
cards.en: Gender equality depends less on statutes than on the quiet assumptions embedded in everyday culture.
cards.use: 开头点题：用 less A than B 表明立意

cards.zh: 人类学家长期以来证明：我们视为天性固定的特质往往是后天习得的。
cards.en: Anthropologists have long shown that what we treat as fixed by nature is often learned.
cards.use: 引入学科视角，作第二段主题句

cards.zh: 刻板印象是思维走的捷径，而正义恰恰最容不得捷径。
cards.en: A stereotype is a shortcut of the mind, and justice is precisely what cannot afford shortcuts.
cards.use: 偏见类话题的主题句，定义加评判

cards.zh: 在许多国家，女性在技能与责任完全相同的工作中所得仍明显更低。
cards.en: In many countries, women still earn markedly less for work that is identical in skill and responsibility.
cards.use: 举例段：薪酬差距的事实陈述

cards.zh: 来自三十个社会的实证研究指向同一方向：家务劳动分配得极不公平。
cards.en: Empirical studies drawn from thirty societies point in the same direction: domestic work is divided with striking unfairness.
cards.use: 引用研究作论据，冒号引出结论

cards.zh: 全球化让人们消费的东西趋于一致，却很少让人们自我认同的方式趋于一致。
cards.en: Globalization homogenizes what people consume; it rarely homogenizes how they identify themselves.
cards.use: 对比段：分号并置两个相反判断

cards.zh: 许多职场歧视源于一个未经审视的假设：总得有人留在家里照顾孩子，而那人通常是女性。
cards.en: Much workplace discrimination stems from an unexamined assumption: that someone, usually a woman, will always be the one who stays home.
cards.use: 因果段：揭示隐性成因

cards.zh: 遗产不是博物馆里的展品，而是祖先与后代之间一场持续进行的对话。
cards.en: Heritage is not a museum piece but a living dialogue between ancestors and their descendants.
cards.use: 文化遗产段主题句：not A but B

cards.zh: 承认生理差异，并不等于把这些差异当作对个人前途的判决。
cards.en: Acknowledging biological differences does not license treating them as a verdict on individual opportunity.
cards.use: 让步后立论，适合反驳段结尾

cards.zh: 修订教材以反映女性的成就，能让教育与我们希望建成的社会保持一致。
cards.en: Revising textbooks to reflect women's achievements puts education in line with the society we claim to want.
cards.use: 对策段：动名词开头，给出可行措施

cards.zh: 不加解释地原样传承仪式，文化会失去感召力；彻底抛弃仪式，社会会失去记忆。
cards.en: A culture that hands its rituals down without explanation loses their authority; one that discards them entirely loses its memory.
cards.use: 结论前段：两极对照，引出折中主张

cards.zh: 衡量一种文明的尺度，不是它多响亮地宣称平等，而是它多安静地兑现平等。
cards.en: The measure of a civilization is not how loudly it proclaims equality, but how quietly it delivers it.
cards.use: 结尾升华：对称结构收束全文
